preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 5000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string is between 1 and 5000.
Each string consists of lowercase Latin letters.
Total length of all strings does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: There are exactly two lines of output for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[2*i] < output_lines[2*i+1] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The first line of each pair is the lexicographically smallest string achievable.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_lines[2*i+1]) <= ns[i] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The second line of each pair is a valid value of k between 1 and the length of the string.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[2*i] == min(modify_string(ss[i], k) for k in range(1, ns[i]+1)) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The first line of each pair is the lexicographically smallest string achievable by any k.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[2*i+1]) == min(k for k in range(1, ns[i]+1) if modify_string(ss[i], k) == output_lines[2*i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The second line of each pair is the smallest k that achieves the lexicographically smallest string.
